description: Set up Strategy Radar for a company: everything a company's own assistant needs to match Antevo's daily business board of risks and opportunities to that company's strategy. Returns the five setup questions (about three minutes, no figures) and the fuller profile, the exposure-tag vocabulary, the matching method, the text of a weekday morning task, the page layout for drawing the radar, and the two disclosure lines. Takes no input: the company's answers stay with its assistant and never reach Antevo.
name: get_strategy_radar_setup
title: Strategy Radar set-up
